mapper.select: SELECT plant_cd, plant_nm, time_zone FROM plant ORDER BY plant_cd
SELECT item_cd, item_nm FROM item WHERE plant_cd = #{plantCd} ORDER BY item_cd
SELECT r.seq, r.proc_cd, p.proc_nm FROM routing r JOIN process p ON p.plant_cd = r.plant_cd AND p.proc_cd = r.proc_cd WHERE r.plant_cd = #{plantCd} AND r.item_cd = #{itemCd} ORDER BY r.seq
SELECT eqp_cd, eqp_nm, proc_cd FROM equipment WHERE plant_cd = #{plantCd} ORDER BY eqp_cd
SELECT defect_cd, defect_nm FROM defect_code ORDER BY defect_cd
